ipam_faculties.name: Accounting & Finance
ipam_faculties.description: Financial Accounting, Auditing, Taxation, Banking, Investment, Financial Services & Financial Economics.

ipam_faculties.name: Information Systems & Technology
ipam_faculties.description: Database Systems, Software Engineering, Networks, Cybersecurity, Web/Mobile Development & Data Analytics.

ipam_faculties.name: Business Administration & Entrepreneurship
ipam_faculties.description: Business Management, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Human Resources, Procurement, Logistics, Marketing & Projects.

ipam_faculties.name: Leadership & Governance
ipam_faculties.description: Public Sector Leadership, Policy Studies, Public Administration, Development Management & Governance.

ipam_faculties.name: Extra-Mural Studies
ipam_faculties.description: Professional diploma and certificate education extending learning into provincial and local communities across Sierra Leone.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc (Hons) in Financial Economics
ipam_programmes.description: Combines economics and finance, developing analytical and quantitative skills for analysing financial markets, economic policy and financial decisions.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, including C6 or better in English, C5 or better in Mathematics, C5 or better in Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting or Economics. Not more than two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Applied Accounting
ipam_programmes.description: A practical accounting degree covering financial reporting, management accounting, audit, and tax applications in real-world business contexts.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Auditing, Taxation and Internal Control
ipam_programmes.description: Specialized training in auditing, taxation, internal controls, financial integrity and regulatory compliance.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, including C6 English, C5 Mathematics and C5 in Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting or Economics, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Banking and Finance
ipam_programmes.description: Comprehensive education in banking operations, financial management, financial institutions and global/local financial markets.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, including C6 English and Mathematics plus C6 in Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting or Economics, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc In Financial Services
ipam_programmes.description: Covers financial services industry operations, investment products, client advisory, and regulatory frameworks.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English and Mathematics plus C6 or better in Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting or Economics, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Computer Networking
ipam_programmes.description: Computer networks, telecommunications systems, network administration, routing/switching and network security.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Information Systems
ipam_programmes.description: Combines computing, business processes and data analytics to teach students how to design, implement and manage information systems supporting organisational processes and decision-making.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, including C6 English and C5 Mathematics plus any three subjects. Applicants are also subjected to a faculty entrance examination.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Information Technology
ipam_programmes.description: Covers professional IT areas such as software development, networking, databases, cybersecurity, web/mobile development and IT project management.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, C6 English, C5 Mathematics plus any three subjects, with faculty entrance examination.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Information Systems
ipam_programmes.description: Practical information systems foundations covering business processes, databases, systems analysis and organisational technology needs.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, including English and Mathematics, plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Business Administration
ipam_programmes.description: General business management and administration, covering organisational behaviour, operations, finance, and business strategy.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, C5 or better in English and Mathematics plus credits in three other subjects, not more than two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Entrepreneurship and Innovation
ipam_programmes.description: Development of entrepreneurial mindset and innovation skills for creating, funding and managing high-growth business ventures.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, C6 English and Mathematics plus three other credits, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Human Resource Management
ipam_programmes.description: Recruitment, talent management, labour relations, performance appraisal and strategic human-resource management.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc in Procurement,Logistics and Supply Chain Management
ipam_programmes.description: Strategic procurement, supply-chain management, inventory logistics, warehouse operations and public/private contracting.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, English and Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc of Science in Project Management
ipam_programmes.description: Project lifecycle management, planning, scheduling, risk mitigation, budgeting, monitoring and resource allocation.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, C6 English and Mathematics plus three other credits, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc of Science in Sales and Marketing
ipam_programmes.description: Sales strategy, consumer behaviour, digital marketing, brand management, customer relations and market analytics.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five O-Level/WASSCE credits, C6 English and Mathematics plus three other C6 credits, within two sittings.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Leadership & Sustainable Development
ipam_programmes.description: Develops ethical, visionary and socially responsible leaders with deep knowledge of governance, sustainable development and public leadership.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Public Policy
ipam_programmes.description: Equips students with analytical tools to formulate, evaluate, and implement impactful public policies in Sierra Leone and West Africa.

ipam_programmes.name: BSc Public Sector Management
ipam_programmes.description: Public administration, civil service management, policy implementation, public financial governance and local government leadership.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Five credits, C5 English, C6 Mathematics and C5 in three relevant liberal-arts subjects such as History, Government, CRK or Economics.

ipam_programmes.name: Master in Development Management (MDM)
ipam_programmes.description: Focuses on strategic planning, implementing, financing and evaluating socio-economic development projects and national programmes.

ipam_programmes.name: Master in Governance and Leadership (MGL)
ipam_programmes.description: Directed toward advanced governance, leadership development, anti-corruption frameworks, and institutional leadership for senior public and private sector officials.

ipam_programmes.name: Master in Public Administration (MPA)
ipam_programmes.description: Premier postgraduate training in executive public-sector management, administrative reform, public financial management and state governance.

ipam_programmes.name: Masters of Research and Public Policy (MRPP)
ipam_programmes.description: Advanced collaborative postgraduate degree focusing on rigorous research methodologies, policy analysis and evidence-based decision-making in Africa.

ipam_programmes.name: Certificate in Business and Finance
ipam_programmes.description: A one-year foundational certificate introducing business, finance, accounting, and commerce fundamentals for workforce entry or progressive study.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Applied Accounting
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma providing applied skills in financial accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, and reporting for commercial and public sector roles.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Banking and Finance
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in banking operations, financial services, credit analysis, and customer relationship management.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Business Administration
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in business principles, office administration, supervision, and organizational management for early career professionals.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Financial Services
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in the financial services sector, covering insurance, microfinance, investments, and client advisory basics.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Information Technology
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in core IT skills including computer hardware, software applications, networking basics, web tools, and digital literacy.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Procurement and Supply
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in procurement principles, purchasing, inventory control, and supply chain administration for public and private institutions.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.

ipam_programmes.name: Diploma in Public Sector Management
ipam_programmes.description: A professional diploma in government administration, public service ethics, civil service procedures, and local administrative management.
ipam_programmes.entry_requirements: Four GCE O-Level/WASSCE credits, with C6 or better in English or Mathematics plus three other subjects.
